_README: Manual meaning-clusters for the embedding-effectiveness study
(ARCHITECTURE.md Task 4a / Contribution 2).
Every complaint below is a REAL complaint taken from
triage_mixed_language_dataset.csv - nothing here is invented, so the
study measures the embedding model on the language the system will
actually meet in the ED.
Clusters are grouped by MEANING, not by the dataset's Category column.
A complaint belongs to exactly one cluster, otherwise the
nearest-neighbour fidelity test in Task 4c is not well defined.
EDIT THIS FILE FREELY - add, remove or move complaints between
clusters and re-run embedding_evaluation.py. Cluster sizes do not have
to be equal; the script computes C(n,2) pairs for whatever size it
finds. A cluster of 10 gives exactly 45 pairs, which is the figure
quoted in the design document.
NOTE on 'burn': the dataset contains only 9 distinct burn complaints,
so that cluster has 9 members (36 pairs) rather than 10. Padding it
with invented text would corrupt the measurement.
NOTE on seizures: the design document suggests a seizure cluster, but
the dataset contains no genuine seizure complaints (the vocabulary in
triage_pipeline.py covers daura/mirgi/fit, yet no patient record uses
them). 'dizziness_weakness' is used instead. This gap is worth
raising - the model cannot be evaluated on a complaint type that was
never collected.
